title: Dev Engineer Backend
full_description:
Senior Java Backend Developer
At ING, we believe in growing our people first. If you’re looking for your next challenge and this role feels like the right step in your career, we’d love to hear from you. If you have any questions or need more details before applying, feel free to reach out to our recruitment team.
As aSenior Java Backend Developer, you will design, build, and maintain backend applications that power our digital banking services. You’ll work on scalable platforms and deliver core banking functionalities used across multiple customer propositions. Your work will ensure high standards of performance, security, and maintainability throughout the development lifecycle.
Develop backend applications following ING standards
Write clean, tested code and perform unit testing
Collaborate with DevOps engineers to manage the full software lifecycle
Embed security best practices into every stage of development
Support bug fixing during SIT and UAT phases
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues
Analyse defects to validate solution design quality
Review technical and functional specifications and perform code reviews
Communicate and escalate issues when necessary
What We’re Looking For
Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
5+ years of experience in a similar role, ideally in a 24/7 banking environment
Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies
Expertise in Java development (J2EE, Spring, Spring Boot)
Advanced skills in REST & SOAP services
Experience with microservices architecture and API management
Familiarity with event-driven systems (MQ, Kafka)
Solid understanding of distributed systems and containerisation (Kubernetes, Docker)
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines
Proficiency in JUnit, TDD, and Spring Integration testing
Nice to have:experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)
Good knowledge of Azure DevOps, DBMS and SQL (Oracle, PL/SQL)
Strong English communication skills (written and spoken)
Additional Preferred Experience
Background inassisting channelssuch as call center, back-office operations, and chat/chatbot solutions
Nice to Have:Experience building AI chatbotsFamiliarity with Virtual Assistant platformsKnowledge of Google DialogFlow CX
Experience building AI chatbots
Familiarity with Virtual Assistant platforms
Knowledge of Google DialogFlow CX
Passion for technology and innovation
Strong execution and results-driven mindset
Team-oriented with excellent communication skills
Problem-solving ability and resilience under pressure
Willingness to provide on-call support when required
Working conditions:Full Time
Location:Milan (hybrid)
ING offers many opportunities to build a diverse and rewarding career. You will be joining an international innovative digital bank, the first in Italy to adopt a fully flexible smart working model, and you will be working in a stimulating environment where you can grow both as an individual and as a professional. Our purpose - empowering people to stay a step ahead in life and in business - represents our belief in people’s potential. We don’t judge, coach or to tell people how to live their lives. We empower people and businesses to realize their own vision for a better future.#doyourthing is our brand direction with us each and every day. It is how we articulate our purpose and our promise to make banking frictionless to the world.‘do your thing’ is about people being free to live the life they want to live, knowing that they will make their world a little better for it.Do you think you are "a step ahead"?
